Grafana Labs | Senior/Staff Software Engineer - AI / Agentic apps | 100% Remote (US + Canada) |

Im the hiring manager - some of the product highlights under the team's scope: - Grafana Assistant: the actually useful AI assistant that helps you do everything in Grafana; it works everywhere - even in OSS! - Investigations: background agents for investigating issues - Grafana Cloud CLI (GCX): CLI covering the entire surface of Grafana Cloud/OSS APIs; plays great with Claude Code/Codex/Cursor and the Assistant - AI Observability: helps you build useful agents and then lets you monitor, eval and improve how they behave - O11y Bench: compare agents' performance across a range of observability/SRE tasks

Our pace of development and innovation is RAPID - the AI Observability product went from being the winning hackathon project to public preview in 6 weeks. We are at the cutting edge here - we are experimenting with autonomous (but safe) SREs, an agentic platform, improving agentic dev experience with o11y insights, fine-tuned LLMs for specific tasks, and more.

We are looking for highly ambitious engineers who have a great sense of ownership, are all-in on agentic development, and have previously built and operated systems at scale. We are all full-stack and love initiative- we would love to talk with you _especially_ if you built something out in the open!

Canada JD: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/grafanalabs/jobs/6100673004 US JD: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/grafanalabs/jobs/6100672004
